findings.one_line: The projection proof silently replaces the FFRCISTG single-world laws of regimes sharing a treatment prefix by an a.s. shared counterfactual prefix in (15)--(17). Reached-history factorization/modularity equate conditional laws, not those cross-world variables; the asserted disagreement event is not generally measurable in the stated Σ_h future vector, so Θ(P)⊆proj_q R(P) and the headline equality are not established under the declared model.
The facet calculation excludes q* only from R(P*); its transfer to Θ(P*) uses the failed projection equality, so the claimed FFRCISTG nonrectangularity witness is not proved.
The inclusion Θ(P)⊆O_n in (34) substitutes the unproved identity Θ(P)=proj_q R(P); without it, P∈K_n certifies coverage only of the reduced polytope, not the stated FFRCISTG identified set.
The row counts and LP certificates are valid for R(P), but their identification as exact certificates for Θ(P) and σ_P rests on the failed projection inclusion.
